0.3.6.changelog:
Web build failed with:
  Type '"error"' is not assignable to type
  '"destructive" | "default" | "success" | undefined'.

The Toast component's Variant union does not include 'error' —
'destructive' is the standard shadcn/radix name for the error style.
Two occurrences fixed:
- page.tsx:166  (Refresh failed toast)
- upgrade-confirm-dialog.tsx:95  (Upgrade could not start toast)
